name: terminal-per-file
description: Pin a dedicated terminal to each file and auto-switch to it when the active editor changes.

commands.title: Terminal Per File: Close Terminal For Current File

enumDescriptions: One dedicated terminal shared by all files in the same directory.
terminalPerFile.scope.description: Whether terminals are pinned per file or per directory.

terminalPerFile.useTmux.description: Back each file's terminal with a persistent tmux session instead of a plain VS Code terminal. The tmux server keeps running independently, so long-running processes survive closing the VS Code window and reattach automatically next time.

terminalPerFile.tmuxSessionPrefix.description: Prefix used when naming the tmux session for each file (only used when useTmux is enabled). Helps you tell these sessions apart in `tmux ls`.

terminalPerFile.tmuxBinary.description: Path to the tmux executable, if it's not on your PATH.

terminalPerFile.includeExtensions.description: File extensions (without the dot, e.g. "R", "Rmd") to pin terminals for. Leave empty to pin terminals for every file (default). Files that don't match are left alone: switching to them neither creates nor shows a pinned terminal.

terminalPerFile.startupCommands.description: Map of file extension (without the dot) to a shell command to run automatically the first time a terminal is created for that file type, e.g. { "R": "R", "Rmd": "R" } to drop into an R console. Only runs once, when the terminal is first created - not on later visits to the same file/directory.

terminalPerFile.respectGitignore.description: Skip files ignored by git (via `git check-ignore`, so nested .gitignore files, global excludes and .git/info/exclude are all honored) - no terminal is pinned for them. Requires git; has no effect outside a git repository or if git isn't installed.

terminalPerFile.ignorePattern.markdownDescription: Advanced. A regular expression (JavaScript syntax) tested against the full file path. Matching files are left alone entirely, even if they match `includeExtensions`. Defaults to skipping common noise (lock files, logs, minified/generated output, `node_modules`/`dist`/`.git`); set to `""` to disable. See [docs/advanced-matching.md](https://github.com/alexg9010/vscode-terminal-per-file/blob/master/docs/advanced-matching.md).

pattern.description: Regular expression (JavaScript syntax) tested against the full file path.

command.description: Shell command to run the first time a terminal is created for a matching file.

terminalPerFile.startupCommandRules.markdownDescription: Advanced. Ordered list of `{ pattern, command }` rules matched against the full file path - first match wins, checked before `startupCommands`. See [docs/advanced-matching.md](https://github.com/alexg9010/vscode-terminal-per-file/blob/master/docs/advanced-matching.md).
